title: Ethiopian Beef Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy stir fry made with juicy beef and inspired by Ethiopian cuisine.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove beef from wok and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then add onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they start to break down, about 2-3 minutes.
Add beef back into the wok and stir in Ethiopian spice blend.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with injera bread.
